name: Watchful Radstag
oracle_text:
Evolve (Whenever a creature you control enters, if that creature has greater power or toughness than this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.)
Whenever this creature evolves, create a token that's a copy of it.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature evolves, create a token that's a copy of it.

needs.what: a trigger event 'evolves' (702.100d) that fires when this permanent's own evolve ability resolves and puts a +1/+1 counter on it, bound to self, so a separate triggered ability can then copy_permanent the source
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Evolve itself is a permanent_enters trigger with an intervening-if (as Fathom Mage writes it), but nothing marks that resolution as an evolve event. counter_placed with source self and counter +1/+1 also fires for proliferate, other cards' counters and any other source of +1/+1 counters, which is a broader card; folding copy_permanent into the evolve trigger's own effects removes the separate trigger that goes on the stack and claims two printed lines with one ability
